inputs.label: Star Wars: X-Wing vs TIE Fighter - Balance of Power Campaigns
inputs.help: Your installed copy of the game with Balance of Power. QGPUI copies the whole folder (about 400 MB).

stores.installDir: STAR WARS X-Wing vs TIE Fighter

steps.why: The guide has the user allow access to all files when the app asks.

steps.text: Open OpenXvT VR from Library > Unknown Sources. If it asks for access to all files, allow it.

notes: Releases are all pre-releases. The Steam app ID and the BalanceOfPower folder come from the upstream OpenXvT README in the repository; the guide names only Steam, the README also GOG (folder name unknown). detect lists a folder, not a file. Granting the appop over adb is not yet tested on a Quest.
